export const ComponentCard = ({ name, description, link, story, previewHeight = 154, previewScale = 0.9 }) => {
  const handleCardClick = (e) => {
    const previewArea = e.currentTarget.querySelector('[data-preview-area]');
    if (!previewArea || !previewArea.contains(e.target)) {
      window.top.location.href = link;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', padding: 20, borderRadius: 12,
        background: 'var(--sb-bg-subtle)', border: '1px solid var(--sb-border)',
        transition: 'all .2s ease', cursor: 'pointer'
      }}
      onClick={handleCardClick}
      onMouseOver={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = 'var(--sb-code-color)'; e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(-2px)'; e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.1)'; }}
      onMouseOut={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = 'var(--sb-border)'; e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(0)'; e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none'; }}
    >
      <div
        data-preview-area="true"
        style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', height: previewHeight, background: 'var(--sb-bg)', borderRadius: 8, marginBottom: 16, overflow: 'hidden', border: '1px solid var(--sb-border-subtle)' }}
      >
        <div style={{ transform: `scale(${previewScale})` }}><Story of={story} /></div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: 15, marginBottom: 6 }}>{name}</div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--sb-text-subtle)', lineHeight: 1.4, marginBottom: 12 }}>{description}</div>
      <div style={{ marginTop: 'auto', paddingTop: 8, fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--sb-code-color)', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>View documentation →</div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const CategorySection = ({ title, anchor, components }) => (
  <div id={anchor} style={{ display: "block", marginTop: 48, marginBottom: 48 }}>
    <h2 style={{ fontSize: 20, marginBottom: 24, paddingBottom: 12, borderBottom: '2px solid var(--sb-border)', textTransform: 'capitalize' }}>{title}</h2>
    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(340px, 1fr))', gap: 24 }}>
      {components.map((c) => <ComponentCard key={c.name} {...c} />)}
    </div>
  </div>
);

export const StatsCards = ({ categories }) => {
  const totalComponents = categories.reduce((acc, cat) => acc + cat.components.length, 0);

  const card1 = (
    <div style={{
      flex: '1 1 260px',
      minWidth: 0,
      padding: '28px 32px',
      borderRadius: 16,
      background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sb-code-color, #0070f3) 0%, #7c3aed 100%)',
      color: '#fff',
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      gap: 8,
      boxShadow: '0 8px 32px rgba(0,112,243,.22)',
      position: 'relative',
      overflow: 'hidden',
    }}>
      <div style={{
        position: 'absolute', top: -40, right: -40,
        width: 140, height: 140, borderRadius: '50%',
        background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.08)',
        pointerEvents: 'none',
      }} />
      <div style={{
        position: 'absolute', bottom: -24, left: -16,
        width: 90, height: 90, borderRadius: '50%',
        background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.05)',
        pointerEvents: 'none',
      }} />
      <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.1em', textTransform: 'uppercase', opacity: .78 }}>
        Components
      </div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 72, fontWeight: 900, lineHeight: 1, letterSpacing: '-3px', margin: '4px 0' }}>
        {totalComponents}
      </div>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 13, opacity: .72, fontWeight: 500 }}>
        across {categories.length} categor{categories.length > 1 ? 'ies' : 'y'}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  const card2 = (
    <div style={{
      flex: '2 1 340px',
      minWidth: 0,
      padding: '24px 28px',
      borderRadius: 16,
      background: 'var(--sb-bg-subtle)',
      border: '1px solid var(--sb-border)',
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.06)',
    }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: '.1em', textTransform: 'uppercase', color: 'var(--sb-text-subtle)', marginBottom: 16 }}>
        Categories
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
        {categories.map((cat, index) => (
          <div key={cat.anchor} style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            padding: '9px 0',
            borderBottom: index < categories.length - 1 ? '1px solid var(--sb-border)' : 'none',
            gap: 12,
          }}>
            <a
              href={'#' + cat.anchor}
              onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); const el = document.getElementById(cat.anchor); if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); }}
              style={{
                fontSize: 14,
                fontWeight: 500,
                color: 'var(--sb-code-color)',
                textDecoration: 'none',
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
              onMouseOver={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.textDecoration = 'underline'; }}
              onMouseOut={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.textDecoration = 'none'; }}
            >
              {cat.title}
            </a>
            <span style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              minWidth: 24,
              height: 20,
              padding: '0 7px',
              borderRadius: 999,
              background: 'var(--sb-code-color, #0070f3)',
              color: '#fff',
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: 700,
              letterSpacing: '.02em',
              flexShrink: 0,
            }}>
              {cat.components.length}
            </span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div style={{
      display: 'flex',
      flexWrap: 'wrap',
      gap: 20,
      marginTop: 32,
      marginBottom: 8,
    }}>
      {card1}
      {card2}
    </div>
  );
};

{/* FSHSP-101: this Storybook redeploys on every push to `main` — it can therefore
    document code ahead of what's installable from npm. This banner makes that gap
    visible instead of silent. Written as inline JSX (no separate `export const`):
    a new named top-level component breaks this page's rendering — Storybook's MDX
    indexer treats it as a missing CSF story rather than a local component, see
    this file's commit. */}
<div style={{
  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10,
  padding: '10px 16px', marginTop: 24, marginBottom: 8,
  borderRadius: 8, background: 'var(--sb-bg-subtle)', border: '1px solid var(--sb-border)',
  fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--sb-text-subtle)',
}}>
  <span aria-hidden="true">📦</span>
  <span>
    Documented version: <strong style={{ color: 'var(--sb-text)' }}>{buildInfo.label}</strong>
    {!buildInfo.isReleased && buildInfo.lastPublished && (
      <> — ahead of <strong style={{ color: 'var(--sb-text)' }}>{buildInfo.lastPublished}</strong> published on npm.</>
    )}
  </span>
</div>

<StatsCards categories={CATEGORIES} />

{CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (
  <CategorySection key={cat.anchor} title={cat.title} anchor={cat.anchor} components={cat.components} />
))}
